BLOCKED_DATA.meaning: No permitted data exists for the test (missing, unpinned, not legally timestamped, not collected).
BLOCKED_DATA.routing: Reopens when the data surface becomes available (collector, vendor, pinned source).

BLOCKED_GOVERNANCE.meaning: A defined unit may not run because a governance rule blocks it (e.g. its frozen data window overlaps a protected or reserved surface).
BLOCKED_GOVERNANCE.routing: Not executable. Only a new explicit permit that removes the conflict reopens it; the old freeze is never edited in place.

BLOCKED_METHOD.meaning: A card was defined but stopped by a method blocker (identification, confounding, lookahead, null model).
BLOCKED_METHOD.routing: Region open. A redesigned card must name and resolve the blocker (RESOLVES_BLOCKER).

CANDIDATE_UNTESTED.meaning: A card or seed exists and passed or awaits feasibility, but no market outcome was computed.
CANDIDATE_UNTESTED.routing: Do not regenerate the same card; it may be selected for feasibility/freeze as is.

CLOSED_BEFORE_START.meaning: A registered or recorded unit was withdrawn before any outcome was computed; it consumed no surface.
CLOSED_BEFORE_START.routing: Inactive. A restart is a new unit with its own registration and permit.

CLOSED_ON_SURFACE.meaning: Tested under a frozen contract; the outcome is specific to the claim or surface (a specific claim rejected, an external reproduction, a mixed result).
CLOSED_ON_SURFACE.routing: Closed on this surface for this function. Reopen only with a new mechanism or a new surface.

CONFIRMED.meaning: A pre-registered confirmation on an independent surface passed; the claim holds under its maintained assumptions on the surfaces tested.
CONFIRMED.routing: Do not re-confirm the same claim. Product use only under its own gate. New work only as a new mechanism or a new surface, never a 'better X' neighbour.

EXPOSED_ONLY.meaning: The data were looked at (descriptively, for the product, or for feasibility) without a confirmatory test.
EXPOSED_ONLY.routing: Cannot serve as confirmation for this mechanism. Discovery elsewhere, confirmation on fresh data.

FUTURE_NATURAL_ACCUMULATION.meaning: Weak now; becomes testable when independent units accumulate naturally.
FUTURE_NATURAL_ACCUMULATION.routing: Revisit at the recorded trigger (date or N). Nothing earlier.

INFORMATIONALLY_WEAK.meaning: The question is legitimate, but there are too few independent units now (MDE above the practical bar).
INFORMATIONALLY_WEAK.routing: Do not run now; no proxy or pooling to manufacture N.

LIVE_SIGNAL.meaning: A discovery or replication result that is not yet confirmed (promising prototype, replicated candidate).
LIVE_SIGNAL.routing: Only a pre-registered confirmation on a fresh surface. No threshold/horizon neighbours.

NO_STRUCTURE.meaning: The mechanism was tested under a frozen contract and gave no practically meaningful effect on this surface.
NO_STRUCTURE.routing: Closed on this surface. Reopen only with a new mechanism or a new surface.

OPEN_FRONTIER.meaning: Nothing has been defined in this cell. The territory is unexplored.
